K_rho: K_{2->1}(rho) = {Delta : Delta is replay-valid, touches at least one exact distance-2 shell term, and after installation lowers d(C_L,C_R) from 2 to <=1}

constructor_expansion.principle: Expand minimally beyond the exhausted one-step source-instance grammar by permitting a bounded two-stage source-derived composition: first a replay-valid source-law instance anchored at a shell term; then a second replay-valid source-law instance whose distinguished endpoint is instantiated with a term produced by the first stage. No synthetic equality edges are allowed.
constructor_expansion.selection: effect-level only; do not privilege named mechanisms before observing a successful member

witnesses.description: Every installed equality replays to the original source law via explicit substitution.
The candidate derivation touches at least one exact frozen distance-2 shell term.
Installation lowers verified cross-distance from 2 to <=1 or closes the target.
Removing the acquired candidate restores cross-distance 2 / removes closure.
No candidate equality is the target equality inserted synthetically.
No Vampire/teacher proof trace or answer label participates in generation.
Candidate generation contains no theorem-id-specific branch beyond loading the frozen residual.
No synthetic bridge edge is admitted without replay to the source law.

admission_rule: headline contraction/closure is insufficient; admit only if all compiled witnesses pass

prediction.primary: If constructor expansion rather than more search is the missing operation, the bounded two-stage replay-valid composition closure will contain at least one witness-complete 2->1 candidate even though the one-step closure contained none.
prediction.obstruction: If zero witness-complete candidates exist, record the two-stage expansion as another explicit grammar obstruction rather than broadening ad hoc.
